Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan ban on building, binding later owners with notice, is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude; common-law negative easements were limited to light, air, support, and stream flow.

Q5623.reason: Footage of a real public protest plus opinion commentary on a matter of public concern is protected by the public-interest privilege, so the privacy claim fails.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest to the sister’s children who reach 25 can vest long after lives in being plus 21 years, so it is void under the RAP and the friend holds fee simple absolute.
